doc: Cup-like open container: thin-wall lathe ('height' profile, open top found from inner-wall evidence, cavity down to base + t) plus every large residual cluster (handle, markers) as a voxel splat. combine 'concat' keeps the splats as separate meshes as lathe_obs.py did (reproduction of the ep21 lathe incumbent); 'union' gives one watertight solid. Windows: the hand kit's absolute windows divided by s of its development episode (GT-free); whether each hand-kit window was set before or after a scan scoring of that kit is not recorded (work-log: two dev scorings per family) - treat them as development choices, not as tuned-free.
